tool_args.rationale: The observations match the guided three-parameter base siphon plus open square-root local branch. With five varied rows, the three parameters are identifiable; no probe is justified. Fit all three numerically with bounded nonlinear least squares.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations span u_now and s_grad with varied values, giving leverage to estimate the three siphon parameters; the supplied subtree guidance says these pilot rows identify them.
No temporal or trajectory signature indicates that this more expensive batch is needed; forecast horizon is short relative to the stated characteristic timescale.
The authorized shared-subtree guidance and pilot signatures support the two-layer siphon form rather than a substrate-only inhibition curve.
All observed s_grad values are at or below 2.2, below the stated supercritical probe threshold; no evidence warrants fitting its extra parameters.
